content.text: GDK-511 lands visibility/jsdPublic in the mirror and gives the CLI --visibility/--internal, but internal/server/write.go handleComment and the web comment box still send body-only comments (always public), and the web issue detail does not mark a restricted/internal comment it renders. Scope: REST passthrough (visibility + internal in the POST body), a web marking badge on restricted/internal comments, and only then a web write control if wanted. Registered as a deliberate scope cut from the GDK-511 round — the read-side columns land first so the surfaces have something to show.
